_comment: Maps friendly agent/service names used in the CSV to the serviceId expected by POST /spendingPolicies/{id}/serviceSettings. The internal API doc does not publish a 'list services' endpoint, so this file is the authoritative mapping for the tool. EDIT THE ServiceId VALUES to match your tenant before committing policies. Run 'Get-CoworkServiceCatalog -FromExistingPolicies' to read the serviceIds already in use by existing policies in your tenant and print a ready-to-paste block. Names and aliases are matched case-insensitively. A raw GUID in the CSV is always accepted and passed through unmapped.
